publisher: Arkansas Secretary of State, Business and Commercial Services

access.automation: The official guide advertises purchase through Business Entity Search, but publishes no supported API, unattended delivery, or recurring automation contract.
access.fees: Charges are calculated by total records; no stable public statewide price was found in the official guide.

fields: The guide identifies existing entity name/address and registered-agent name/address, with lists selectable by domestic/foreign and profit/nonprofit type; no exact machine schema is published.
active_status_semantics: Certificates distinguish existence and good standing, but neither is proof of present operation; no bulk status dictionary is published.
statewide_completeness: The product is described as listings of existing business entities by selected corporate types, not all operating organizations; sole proprietorships generally are not filed with SOS.
address_and_zip: Entity and agent addresses are advertised, but ZIP presence and address-role definitions are not guaranteed; registered-agent data is excluded from entity geocoding.
redistribution: The official guide establishes purchase availability, not retention, transformation, geocoding, derived-publication, or redistribution permission.
temporal_refresh: No snapshot timestamp, update cadence, replacement/delta/deletion semantics, replay, manifest, checksum, or change notice is published.

citations.supports: bulk listing availability, fields, type filters, record-count pricing, registration limits
official BCS authority and business search service

next_action: Request unsigned terms and a header-only person-free schema, counts, price, status/address dictionaries, refresh controls, supported automation, and redistribution rights if authorized later. Do not order, pay, sign up, scrape, download, or execute production from this assessment.
